faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Strata and how it works.
faq.q1: How does the leave management system work?
faq.a1: Our platform streamlines the entire leave request process. Employees can submit requests through an intuitive interface, managers receive instant notifications for approval, and all leave balances are automatically tracked and updated in real-time.
faq.q2: Can I integrate this with my existing HR tools?
faq.a2: Yes! We offer seamless integrations with popular HR platforms, payroll systems, and calendar applications. Our API allows for custom integrations to fit your specific workflow needs.
faq.q3: What kind of reports can I generate?
faq.a3: You can generate comprehensive reports on leave trends, attendance patterns, team availability, and employee balances. All reports are exportable in PDF, Excel, and CSV formats with customizable date ranges and filters.
faq.a4: Absolutely. We use bank-level encryption (SSL/TLS), regular security audits, and comply with GDPR and other data protection regulations. Your data is stored in secure, redundant data centers with automatic backups.
faq.a5: Getting started is easy! Sign up for a free trial, add your team members, configure your leave policies, and you're ready to go. Our onboarding team will guide you through the setup process and answer any questions.
faq.a6: We offer multiple support channels including email support, live chat, comprehensive documentation, and video tutorials. Professional and Enterprise plans include priority support and dedicated account managers.

personio.tagline: Europe's HRIS for small and mid-sized companies, strongest in German-speaking markets.
personio.win1: Payroll and works-council compliance for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, built with local lawyers rather than bolted on.
personio.win2: A large partner and implementation network in the DACH region, so change management is rarely your problem alone.
personio.win3: A decade of refinement on employee records, document workflows and reporting for European HR teams.
personio.our1: Armenian payroll reality: payslips, SRC-ready tax export and Armsoft sync instead of a DACH-only compliance story.
personio.our2: Attendance with face recognition, shift scheduling and time tracking are in the box, not licences you buy separately.
personio.our3: Built-in chat, video meetings, projects and e-signatures: one bill instead of five stitched-together vendors.
personio.our4: Armenian and Russian interface with Armenian-speaking support; Personio ships English and German first.
personio.verdict: Personio is the safer choice when your entity, payroll and legal obligations sit in Germany, Austria or Switzerland. Strata wins when your company is in Armenia or the CIS — and when you would rather run one platform than integrate an HRIS with four point tools.
personio.bestFor: Choose Personio if your legal entity and payroll run in DACH and you need their works-council and payroll-certified workflows.
personio.notFor: Choose Strata if you file with the Armenian SRC, need Armenian or Russian for employees, or want attendance, meetings and projects in the same platform.

bamboohr.tagline: The US SMB standard: clean, quick to deploy, with payroll handled through partners.
bamboohr.win1: Onboarding and time-off experiences employees describe as pleasant — a real differentiator in retention-sensitive teams.
bamboohr.win2: Instant recognition with US buyers and an implementation measured in days rather than months.
bamboohr.win3: A mature add-on marketplace, native mobile apps and a reporting builder managers actually use.
bamboohr.our1: Payroll that fits Armenia: local runs, payslips and SRC-ready export, where BambooHR routes non-US payroll to partners.
bamboohr.our2: Biometric and face-recognition attendance, shifts and overtime in one module; BambooHR leaves them to integrations.
bamboohr.our3: Built-in chat, video conferencing, tasks and projects — no Slack, Zoom and PM tool bought alongside.
bamboohr.our4: Armenian, Russian and German interfaces with full Armenian localisation; BambooHR is English-first.
bamboohr.verdict: BambooHR is the low-risk choice for a US company that wants the basics done well and will buy payroll from a partner. Strata is the better answer for Armenia and the CIS: the statutory filings, payment rails and languages BambooHR will never build.
bamboohr.bestFor: Choose BambooHR if you are a US-headquartered SMB without non-US payroll complexity.
bamboohr.notFor: Choose Strata when your payroll, statutory reporting or staff language is not American.

hibob.tagline: Engagement and retention focused HRIS — strong on people experience, silent on time and payroll.
hibob.win1: Employee-experience tooling: shout-outs, surveys and a feed employees actually open.
hibob.win2: Flexible org structures and multi-entity support that scale with fast-growing global teams.
hibob.win3: Polished mobile apps and a clean interface that drives genuine weekly engagement.
hibob.our1: Time and attendance is native — face-recognition kiosks, shifts and overtime. HiBob has no attendance module at all.
hibob.our2: Payroll inside the product, including Armenian payslips and SRC-ready export, instead of a hand-off to an integrator.
hibob.our3: Meetings, chat, projects and tasks live in the same platform rather than in another subscription.
hibob.our4: Armenian and Russian localisation and support for the teams who work in those languages.
hibob.verdict: HiBob is the pick when engagement and culture are the bottleneck and time-tracking and payroll already live elsewhere. Strata covers both sides of that equation, so once people actually clock in we are the cheaper end state.
hibob.bestFor: Choose HiBob for a globally spread, salaried, culture-first team that needs no attendance tracking.
hibob.notFor: Choose Strata when employees clock in, shifts matter or payroll is local.

rippling.tagline: HR, IT and finance on one platform — the strongest US payroll and device-management engine.
rippling.win1: US payroll, benefits and device/access management that no HR-only platform can match.
rippling.win2: Extensibility most rivals cannot copy: from offer letter to laptop to app access in a single flow.
rippling.win3: A fast-shipping product organisation with deep US and EU compliance work behind it.
rippling.our1: Armenian statutory reality: SRC tax export, Armsoft sync and Idram/ArCa payment rails, none of which are on Rippling's roadmap.
rippling.our2: Armenian, Russian and German interfaces with Armenian-language support for the people who use the system daily.
rippling.our3: Built-in attendance with face recognition, meeting rooms and video conferencing — Rippling expects you to bring those.
rippling.our4: Predictable pricing for a 20–200 person team, without per-module enterprise contracts.
rippling.verdict: Rippling wins for a US company that wants HR and IT provisioned together. Strata wins where the substance is Armenian employment practice, local payment rails and a workforce reading Armenian — and where you do not need MDM or US benefits brokerage.
rippling.bestFor: Choose Rippling if US payroll, benefits and device management are the core of your problem.
rippling.notFor: Choose Strata if your payroll and statutory reporting are Armenian and your team works in Armenian or Russian.

leapsome.tagline: Performance, goals and learning platform — a specialist for talent and development.
leapsome.win1: Best-in-class reviews, 360 feedback and OKR linking, with strong templates and calibration workflows.
leapsome.win2: Learning depth: paths, courses and skill frameworks that outrun generalist HR suites.
leapsome.win3: Engagement surveys with benchmarks your managers can act on.
leapsome.our1: Strata is the whole system of record — employee data, attendance, leave and payroll — not only the development layer.
leapsome.our2: Recruitment, onboarding, offboarding and e-signatures sit next to performance instead of beside it in another tool.
leapsome.our3: Time tracking with biometric kiosks and local payroll, which Leapsome deliberately does not do.
leapsome.our4: Armenian and Russian localisation plus local compliance; Leapsome is built for European enterprise HR teams.
leapsome.verdict: Leapsome is the better product once HRIS, attendance and payroll are already solved and you want a development-focused overlay. If they are not, Strata is the shorter path: the performance module ships with the platform instead of on top of it.
leapsome.bestFor: Choose Leapsome if your system of record is settled and reviews, goals and learning are the pain.
leapsome.notFor: Choose Strata if the system of record itself is what you are still trying to build.

deel.tagline: Global payroll and EOR for distributed companies — contractor payments and compliance in 100+ countries.
deel.win1: Global payroll and employer-of-record infrastructure: hire in a new country without creating an entity.
deel.win2: Contractor management, compliance and payments at a depth no HRIS-only vendor approaches.
deel.win3: Country coverage and payroll operations support for genuinely distributed teams.
deel.our1: Deel is not an HRIS: attendance, leave, shifts, performance, chat and projects are not its product — they are ours.
deel.our2: Local Armenian payroll and SRC-ready reporting plus Idram/ArCa rails, rather than routing everything through global payroll.
deel.our3: Armenian and Russian interface for the staff who open the system every morning.
deel.our4: One platform price for HR operations instead of per-contract global payroll fees.
deel.verdict: Deel and Strata are complements rather than substitutes: if you must employ people in ten countries, Deel does that and we do not. If your team is concentrated in Armenia and needs one operating system for HR, Deel leaves most of the daily work unaddressed.
deel.bestFor: Choose Deel when you are hiring contractors or employees across many countries and need global payroll or EOR.
deel.notFor: Choose Strata when your team sits in Armenia and the daily HR work matters more than global payroll coverage.

armsoft.tagline: Armenia's incumbent accounting and ERP suite — the payroll and bookkeeping many local accountants already run.
armsoft.win1: Accounting and payroll built for Armenian legislation and trusted by finance teams for years.
armsoft.win2: An established accountant and integrator network across Armenia — your auditor probably already knows it.
armsoft.win3: Native Armenian statutory reports and direct acquaintance with SRC filing formats.
armsoft.our1: Employee self-service, attendance, leave and approvals that an accounting ERP was never built to give staff.
armsoft.our2: A real-time web platform instead of an installed desktop suite renewed through a partner.
armsoft.our3: Recruitment, performance, documents and e-signatures in one place, not only finance and payroll.
armsoft.our4: Works alongside Armsoft: we export and sync rather than ask you to abandon your books.
armsoft.verdict: Armsoft is the accountant's system, and it is good at that. Strata is the employee's and the HR team's system. Most Armenian companies should keep Armsoft for the books and run Strata for people operations — we integrate instead of forcing a replacement.
armsoft.bestFor: Keep Armsoft for statutory accounting and the finance department's books.
armsoft.notFor: Choose Strata for everything the employee and HR touch: time, leave, hiring, reviews and communication.

onec.tagline: The HR and payroll module of 1C, one of the most widely used systems in the CIS, localised by country partners.
onec.win1: Very deep payroll and HR calculation, with country-localised legislation across the CIS.
onec.win2: A huge partner and accountant ecosystem, so implementation and support are available almost everywhere.
onec.win3: Flexibility that large finance and HR departments can shape to unusual local rules.
onec.our1: A cloud product employees actually use on a phone — self-service, self check-in and requests.
onec.our2: Modern interfaces and real-time collaboration instead of an installed client.
onec.our3: Attendance with face recognition, shifts, chat, video and projects in the same subscription.
onec.our4: Armenian-first localisation and support, priced for a 20–200 person team.
onec.verdict: 1C is stronger where payroll calculation is the whole job and a partner customises it. Strata is stronger for the daily HR experience and for a team that wants to work from a browser and a phone. For many CIS companies they coexist: 1C for the calculation, Strata for the people.
onec.bestFor: Choose 1C when complex, customised payroll calculation is the core requirement.
onec.notFor: Choose Strata when you want self-service HR and attendance without an implementation project.

staffam.tagline: Armenia's leading HR-tech and jobs platform — strongest in recruitment and employer branding.
staffam.win1: A large Armenian candidate audience and the strongest local recruitment reach.
staffam.win2: Employer-branding and assessment tooling that HR teams here already know.
staffam.win3: A deep local recruitment focus, including job-board reach no global HRIS has in Armenia.
staffam.our1: Staff.am is recruitment; Strata is the whole system of record — records, time, leave, payroll and development.
staffam.our2: A complete HRIS behind the hire: onboarding, attendance, reviews and documents in one place.
staffam.our3: Payroll and Armenian statutory reporting, which a jobs platform does not attempt.
staffam.our4: Works as a channel alongside it: advertise roles widely, then run everyone inside Strata.
staffam.verdict: Staff.am is where Armenian candidates are and a good place to advertise roles. Strata is where those hires then live. They solve different parts of the same problem, and most teams use both.
staffam.bestFor: Use Staff.am for candidate reach and employer branding in Armenia.
staffam.notFor: Choose Strata to run the people who are already on payroll.

peopleforce.tagline: A CIS/CEE HRIS with broad HR coverage and Russian-language support.
peopleforce.win1: A familiar Russian-language HRIS for CIS teams, with a wide module set.
peopleforce.win2: Established in Eastern Europe with localisation and support across the region.
peopleforce.win3: Recognition, surveys and performance depth aimed at engagement.
peopleforce.our1: Armenian statutory reality: SRC export, Armsoft sync and Idram/ArCa rails — not a CIS-wide generic.
peopleforce.our2: A native Armenian interface, not only Russian, for staff who read Armenian.
peopleforce.our3: Attendance with face-recognition kiosks, shift scheduling and built-in video meetings.
peopleforce.our4: Armenian-speaking support in your time zone and pricing built for the Armenian market.
peopleforce.verdict: PeopleForce is a credible choice for a Russian-speaking CIS team that wants a general HRIS. Strata goes further where the market is specifically Armenian — the filings, the payment rails and the language — and pairs that with the same breadth of modules.
peopleforce.bestFor: Choose PeopleForce for a Russian-first CIS team wanting a broad HRIS.
peopleforce.notFor: Choose Strata when Armenian compliance, Armenian-language staff and local payment rails matter.

odoo.tagline: Open-source ERP with an HR module — cheap, flexible and partner-customised.
odoo.win1: One open-source suite for the whole business — CRM, accounting, inventory and HR — at a low price.
odoo.win2: Extreme flexibility through a large module ecosystem and community.
odoo.win3: Strong value for cost-sensitive SMBs that standardise on a single ERP.
odoo.our1: An HR product designed around HR, not one module inside a general ERP.
odoo.our2: Deep HR depth: reviews, OKRs, recruitment, learning, succession and raises.
odoo.our3: Armenian compliance — SRC export, Armsoft sync — and an Armenian interface out of the box.
odoo.our4: Attendance with face recognition, shifts and video meetings, ready without partner customisation.
odoo.verdict: Odoo is a smart buy when you want one cheap ERP for the whole company and HR is a small part of it. Strata is the deeper HR system, cheaper than the partner time Odoo usually takes, and Armenian by default.
odoo.bestFor: Choose Odoo when HR is one module of a company-wide ERP decision.
odoo.notFor: Choose Strata when HR is the priority and you want it working without a customisation project.

hirebee.tagline: Armenian HR platform that started in recruitment and grew into an HRMS with payroll, reviews and a mobile app.
hirebee.win1: Recruitment is their origin: applicant pipelines, talent pools, structured screening and AI candidate scoring.
hirebee.win2: Assessment tooling for candidates — the layer almost no HRIS builds.
hirebee.win3: Desktop and mobile apps, plus reference customers among larger Armenian employers.
hirebee.our1: They are strong before the hire, we are strong after it — time, leave, payroll, documents and development.
hirebee.our2: Armenian payroll depth: Tax Code art. 141, funded pension, military stamp duty, health insurance, SRC-ready export and Idram/ArCa.
hirebee.our3: Platform depth: SSO/SCIM, public API with signed webhooks, audit log, GDPR toolkit and e-signatures.
hirebee.our4: The finance contour they do not cover: expenses with policies and limits, benefits with claim wallets, assets.
hirebee.verdict: Both products are Armenian and both span HR, so the decision is about the centre of gravity. If the pain is hiring and candidate assessment, Hirebee is the honest recommendation. If the pain is running people after the hire — shifts, time, payroll and compliance — Strata is deeper.
hirebee.bestFor: Choose Hirebee when recruitment and candidate assessment are the priority.
hirebee.notFor: Choose Strata when the priority is payroll, time and compliance for people you have already hired.

listwork.tagline: Broad Armenian workplace platform from the List.am team: people, hiring, performance, attendance, payroll and tasks.
listwork.win1: The List.am brand: recognition and trust in Armenian SMB that a new vendor cannot buy.
listwork.win2: Breadth in one product — recruitment, onboarding, reviews, goals, absence, time tracking, payroll, tasks and a knowledge base.
listwork.win3: Armenian, Russian and English interfaces with mobile apps for employees and managers.
listwork.our1: Armenian tax depth rather than payroll as a feature: tax rules as an engine, organisation-level overrides, SRC-ready export.
listwork.our2: Six jurisdictions in the tax engine — Armenia, Russia, Germany, UK, Poland, US federal — a route out of Armenia, not only within it.
listwork.our3: Platform depth: server-side plan enforcement, SSO/SCIM, public API with signed webhooks, audit log, GDPR toolkit and backups.
listwork.our4: The whole finance contour: expenses with limits, benefits with claim wallets, assets, e-signature envelopes with an audit trail.
listwork.verdict: List Work is locally the closest product to ours in scope, and its brand advantage is real. We win where the deal is about compliance, finance and platform integration rather than familiarity.
listwork.bestFor: Choose List Work when a familiar Armenian brand and a broad all-in-one at a small-company price point matter most.
listwork.notFor: Choose Strata when you need Armenian tax depth, SSO/SCIM, an API or a finance contour beyond payroll.

resalt.tagline: Armenian HR and operations platform with an unusually deep performance and calibration layer.
resalt.win1: Performance depth: 360-degree reviews with calibration sessions, plus growth plans tied to outcomes.
resalt.win2: Structured interviews with scorecards and offer workflows — more hiring rigour than a plain ATS.
resalt.win3: Pulse surveys, eNPS and engagement, with AI-assisted goal setting and sentiment analysis.
resalt.our1: Payroll and tax: runs, payslips, Armenian tax rules and SRC-ready export, right next to the people data.
resalt.our2: Platform: SSO/SCIM, public API with webhooks, audit log, GDPR toolkit and server-side plan enforcement.
resalt.our3: A wider operational surface: expenses, benefits, assets, e-signatures, video meetings and meeting rooms.
resalt.our4: Attendance and shift scheduling for hourly and shift-based teams, not only for salaried staff.
resalt.verdict: Resalt is the better product if performance calibration is the deciding criterion — we do not run calibration sessions, and we should say so. Strata wins when payroll, compliance and platform requirements are on the list.
resalt.bestFor: Choose Resalt when reviews and calibration are the core need.
resalt.notFor: Choose Strata when payroll, Armenian compliance or integration requirements decide the deal.

sparkwork.tagline: Armenian platform that pairs people management with strategy execution — strategy maps, balanced scorecards, OKRs and initiatives.
sparkwork.win1: Strategy execution as the product: strategy maps, balanced scorecards and initiative tracking in one place.
sparkwork.win2: Executive reporting that connects goals, KPIs and progress for leadership.
sparkwork.win3: AI assistants and workflows across the platform, plus mobile and a Power BI integration.
sparkwork.our1: Strategy and OKRs sit next to payroll, time and compliance rather than beside them — one subscription, no second vendor.
sparkwork.our2: Armenian payroll and tax: SRC-ready export and local payment rails; payroll is not part of their product.
sparkwork.our3: Public API with signed webhooks, SSO/SCIM and audit logging: your data is available where you need it, not only in a dashboard.
sparkwork.our4: Operational HR depth: shift scheduling, expenses with policies, benefits, assets and signed documents.
sparkwork.verdict: If the buying committee is the executive team and the question is strategy execution, Spark.work is a legitimate choice. Strata matches the goals layer and adds the HR and payroll system of record underneath it.
sparkwork.bestFor: Choose Spark.work when strategy execution is the primary purchase and HR is supporting.
sparkwork.notFor: Choose Strata when strategy, OKRs, payroll and compliance belong in one system.

ontime.tagline: Armenian time and attendance system built around ZKTeco access-control hardware.
ontime.win1: Hardware biometrics: face, palm, fingerprint, card, code and QR terminals — we are not integrated with these devices.
ontime.win2: Schedule-deviation tracking and attendance reporting designed for shift-based operations.
ontime.win3: Employee self-service pages and request approvals on top of the terminals.
ontime.our1: Attendance judged with everything it affects: shifts, overtime, leave balances and the payroll run itself.
ontime.our2: Camera-based recognition needs no hardware purchase or installation, which fits offices and distributed teams.
ontime.our3: Payroll, hiring, development, documents and communication — the punch is the start of a process, not the product.
ontime.our4: A modern platform around it: SSO, mobile-friendly self-service, notifications and reporting.
ontime.verdict: OnTime is the right answer when terminals are already installed or required, and we should say that plainly instead of competing on biometrics we do not have. Strata wins where attendance is one input into payroll and operations rather than the whole problem.
ontime.bestFor: Choose OnTime when you need physical access-control terminals on site.
ontime.notFor: Choose Strata when attendance must feed shifts, overtime and payroll in one system.

security.metaDescription: How Strata protects your HR data: encryption, role-based access, audit trails, SSO/SCIM, AI guardrails, backups and GDPR data-subject rights.
security.title: Security at Strata
security.subtitle: Your HR data is the most sensitive data your company owns. Here is exactly how we protect it — no vague promises, only capabilities that are live in the product today.
security.encryptionTitle: Encryption in transit and at rest
security.encryptionBody: All traffic runs over TLS. Data at rest is encrypted by our infrastructure providers. Passwords are never stored in readable form — only salted hashes — and password-only users can add passkeys (WebAuthn) for phishing-resistant sign-in.
security.rbacBody: Every request is authorized server-side against a five-level role hierarchy (superadmin, admin, supervisor, driver, employee) plus per-employee capabilities. Clients never decide access — the backend refuses unauthorized reads and writes regardless of what the UI shows.
security.auditBody: Sensitive actions — approvals, payroll changes, document signing, impersonation, GDPR operations — are recorded in an append-only audit log with actor, action, target, details and IP address, visible to organization admins in the Security Center.
security.ssoBody: Sign in through your identity provider with OIDC single sign-on (authorization-code flow with PKCE, strict email-domain allowlists). SCIM 2.0 keeps the employee directory in sync automatically: new hires are provisioned, leavers are deactivated — and SCIM can never create or disable administrators.
security.aiBody: The AI assistant runs behind per-organization guardrails with request-level logging (agent, action, allowed/blocked, tokens, latency). Every AI decision path is auditable and can be restricted or disabled by your admins.
security.backupsBody: Per-employee and per-organization backups are created on demand and on schedule through the platform backup engine, so your data can be restored even after an error or a malicious action.
security.dataRightsBody: Export, anonymize or erase any data subject from a single superadmin toolkit that searches every module for the person’s footprint and logs the operation. Data-processing terms are available on request; a DPIA summary for the AI features can be provided.
security.esignBody: Offers, leave orders and policies are signed with a full signature trail (who, when, from where) and archived as PDF, giving you a defensible audit trail for every HR decision.
security.soc2Note: Gap assessment complete; audit scheduled as part of the enterprise readiness program.
security.isoNote: Planned after SOC 2, following the same ISMS groundwork.
security.gdprNote: Data-subject rights tooling, minimal data retention and processor terms are live in the product.
security.infrastructureBody: We host on established infrastructure providers and keep the sub-processor list deliberately short:
security.infraConvex: Convex — primary application database and function hosting (EU/US regions with encryption at rest).
security.infraCloudinary: Cloudinary — media storage for avatars and attachments.
security.infraLivekit: LiveKit — video meetings media relay (media can be self-hosted for sensitive customers).
security.disclosureBody: Found a vulnerability? Please report it to us — we treat every report seriously, respond quickly and will not pursue legal action for good-faith research. Reach us via the contact page and include the word “security” in your message.
security.trustCenterBody: Beyond this page: who processes your data, the agreement we process it under, and the service levels we commit to.
